d: India is stepping up its fight against drugs, narco-funded terror and emerging security threats. Under the “Drug-Free India by 2029” campaign, the government is deploying AI, satellites and drones to track drug trafficking from the Western “Death Crescent” of Iran, Afghanistan and Pakistan, and the Eastern “Death Triangle” involving Laos, Thailand and Myanmar. Rajasthan recorded the highest drug seizures, followed by Odisha and Madhya Pradesh.
